capture.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, 610.62, 97887 MiB, 93328 MiB

selection.rule: The explicitly selected graph has exactly one camera View payload with ViewRectMin (0,0,0,0) and ViewSizeAndInvSize (1280,720).

scene_color_transform.method: single shared exposure + Reinhard + sRGB OETF
scene_color_transform.statement: Both SceneColor versions use exactly this transform; no independent percentile, exposure or tone curve is applied to either version.

format_policy.rule: Every source is decoded from Base/SubresourceLayouts.json StoredFormat plus the actual file bytes per texel, not from the descriptor's NativeFormat or an assumed half2/half4 layout.
format_policy.rgba16f_note: PF_FloatRGBA is RGBA16F in this capture (8 bytes/texel), including BC7/BC5/BC6H exports whose stored format is PF_FloatRGBA. The decoder uses bytes_per_texel = ByteSize/(ExtentX*ExtentY*ZSliceCount); if a file is 16 bytes/texel it is decoded as float32 RGBA instead.
format_policy.packed_formats: PF_FloatRGB == PF_FloatR11G11B10 (4 bytes/texel); decoded as 11/11/10. PF_A2B10G10R10 is decoded as native 10/10/10/2. R/G/B/A channel order is preserved per compound format.
format_policy.channel_provenance: Every figure records source format, stored format, storage bytes per texel, decoder storage class, BitExact/ValuePreserving and StoredBytesAreNativeStorage.

unavailable.evidence: GBufferC.A is exactly 0 (background) or 255 (opaque) in this capture. EncodeGBuffer has two compile-time branches (GBufferAO vs DiffuseIndirectSampleOcclusion bitmask); no shader permutation define is captured, so a radiometric meaning would be a guess. GBufferB.A shading model and A per-object masks are decoded instead.

GBufferD is PF_B8G8R8A8 and all 5,683,200 bytes are 0; CustomData is only valid for subsurface/skin shading models (HasCustomGBufferData, DeferredShadingCommon.ush:345-350), none of which are present.

The buffer has 60,480 half values = 80*84 probes * 9 SH coefficients. A direction-resolved SH figure would require applying the engine band weights and octahedral convolution; the per-texel LightingProbabilityDensityFunction figure is included instead. The raw buffer remains in the final dump.
The 4-probe bilinear/plane weights are computed inside ScreenProbeIntegrateCS from depth/normal/depth weights and are not a dumped RDG resource. The PDF and hit-distance inputs are included.
Graph 0001 exposes GBufferA-D. The capture has no GBufferE or GBufferVelocity descriptor for this graph.
The figures show the card-capture atlases. Lumen.Cards and Lumen.MeshCards structured payloads are available through the capture and the source schema.

The baseline VSM mask/vpage/cache PNGs and lit baseline come from dump binary-20261112-133826, an earlier run. They are not included or relabelled as final-run figures. This final-run figure set uses Shadow.Virtual.MaskBits and Shadow.Virtual.PageTable payloads.

unavailable.evidence: DumpGPU stores engine render-target radiance values; no calibrated luminance meter, exposure EXR or reference transport image is part of this dump. Figures record engine units and a declared display transform, not candela/m2.

limitations: All decoded figures are exact displays of stored GPU payloads, not re-renders. No GPU or engine work was executed to produce them.

HDR display transforms are per-figure and declared in each figure's display.transform; they are not radiometric comparisons across figures. SceneColor before/after is the sole figure set with one shared transform.

Source textures are natively 1280x888 with 168 padding rows; screen figures crop to the exact declared 1280x720 view rect. Non-screen atlases are shown at their own extent/crop and are not resized to 1280x720.
VSM renderer debug screenshots from the baseline evidence run (dump binary-20261112-133826) are an earlier run and are deliberately not included or relabelled here.
Absolute photometric calibration (candela/m2) is not available from the DumpGPU payload alone; radiance figures record engine render-target units.
